answer: Each autonomous agent must lock a unique hardware enclave attestation as a root anchor before participating in consensus. When an adversary attempts to spawn hundreds of ephemeral bots, the attestation requirement cannot simply echo across forged accounts, forcing the attacker to purchase real physical secure chips for every seat. Because the capital expenditure scales linearly while malicious returns vanish like a comet across a single epoch, large-scale puppet swarms become economically unviable.
